summary: Jackson County platform and camp dated 1935 and abandoned in the 1940s; one detailed listing, with a possible mix-up with the Klamath County Mule Hill.

facts.status_note: Listed as abandoned in the 1940s; no source says what, if anything, remains at the site.

evidence.supports: 1935 platform and camp; abandoned in the 1940s
about 26 miles southwest of Crater Lake
Klamath FPA named on the listing
listed as a platform, abandoned, no date
a separate Mule Hill is in Klamath County

notes_for_editor: Possible conflation with us-or-mule-hill-2 (Klamath County). This page gives 2,855 ft, the same figure the FFLOS register (US 1773, OR 513) gives for the Klamath site, while firelookout.com gives that site 5,149 ft. The Oregon Lookouts directory lists Mule Hill only under Klamath County. The FFLA list has two Mule Hill entries with different coordinates, so it may be a real second site. Recommend a human check whether this record duplicates us-or-mule-hill-2 before either is published. No correction proposed, because this record matches its own source page. Story is short; no source gives a year for the abandonment or describes the site now.
